articles.title: Swiss stablecoin sandbox enters testing phase, adds two new partners
articles.description: Financial market operator SIX and payment app TWINT have joined numerous banks in the sandbox seeking to develop a Swiss franc-based stablecoin.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Australia says it removed 45 crypto, remittance registrations over the past year
articles.description: AUSTRAC said its yearlong sweep included canceled, suspended and unrenewed registrations, while its action against GetCoins helped disrupt organized investment scams.

articles.title: Liquid ‘white hats’ return $270M in Bitcoin as network prepares restart
articles.description: The actors returned 85% of the Bitcoin withdrawn from Liquid’s federation wallet following the security incident.

articles.title: UK financial watchdog weighs lifting prediction markets ban: Report
articles.description: Companies offering binary options for retail investors have been barred from selling, marketing and distributing products in the UK since 2019 following a directive from the FCA.

articles.title: Ethereum Foundation names 2 ‘must ship’ EIPs for Hegotá upgrade
articles.description: Ethereum’s Hegotá upgrade will center on FOCIL and Frame Transactions as developers weigh dozens of other proposed changes for inclusion.

articles.title: Joe Biden’s son to launch memecoin, will send to TRUMP holders: WSJ
articles.description: Hunter Biden will reportedly distribute 200 million of the LAPTOP token to his substack subscribers, members of a mailing list and investors in President Donald Trump’s memecoin.

articles.title: Polish prosecutors charge suspect in Zondacrypto probe, seek pretrial detention
articles.description: Polish prosecutors charged Romana Ż. with organized crime and misappropriation offenses involving $2.1 million in Zondacrypto user funds.

articles.title: Bitcoin fund flows show investors trading Fed rate path, not exiting market: CoinShares
articles.description: Bitcoin’s struggle to break $80,000 comes as markets price in a growing chance of a September rate hike, putting monetary conditions back in focus.

articles.title: Capital B adds 376 Bitcoin in $29M purchase, boosting holdings to 3,521 BTC
articles.description: Capital B’s latest Bitcoin purchase was its largest in nearly a year, pushing the French company ahead of H100 Group among publicly traded BTC holders.

articles.title: Bitcoin chips away at weekend upside as $80K hangs in the balance
articles.description: Bitcoin price fell 2% in low-liquidity conditions as the US Labor Day holiday saw $80,000 once again slip from bulls’ grasp.

articles.title: Zcash hits highest price since 2016 as market cap tops $20B
articles.description: ZEC gained 45% over the past week, extending its rally since Grayscale converted its Zcash Trust into an ETF that began trading Aug. 25.

articles.title: Yen intervention meets US inflation data: Five things to know in Bitcoin this week
articles.description: This week’s CPI and PPI prints, along with the Fed’s Sept. 16 rate decision, could determine whether Bitcoin can secure $80,000 as a support level.

articles.title: Citi, DBS complete first weekend tokenized cross-border deposit on Swift
articles.description: Citi and DBS completed their first tokenized cross-border transfer over the weekend, using Swift’s blockchain-based ledger to circumvent the constraints of traditional banking hours.

articles.title: Philippines eyes payment operator registration freeze, tighter VASP checks
articles.description: A central bank proposal would pause new payment operator registrations while requiring enhanced monitoring and transaction limits for arrangements involving virtual asset firms.

articles.title: Coldcard third-wave attacker moves 45% of stolen Bitcoin
articles.description: Galaxy said 82% of Bitcoin stolen across all Coldcard attacks remains in the original addresses, with 18% moved in apparent laundering.

articles.title: Fomo overtakes Pump.fun in daily revenue on Solana
articles.description: Fomo generated $1.76 million on Friday, beating Pump.fun’s $1.1 million, though the memecoin launchpad remains ahead over 30 days.

articles.title: Bitcoin sidechain Liquid pauses after purported ‘white hats’ withdraw $320M in BTC
articles.description: The actors told Blockstream they would return most of the 4,000 BTC after the Elements vulnerability is patched across the network.

articles.title: Harmony proposes shutting down layer 1, migrating ONE to Ethereum
articles.description: Harmony proposed sunsetting its layer-1 blockchain and migrating ONE to Ethereum, weeks after an exploit led to plans to discard 109,000 transactions.

articles.title: ‘White hats’ take 4000 BTC from Liquid, ETFs see best inflows of 2026: Hodler’s Digest
articles.description: Purported white hat hackers have taken 4000 Bitcoin from the Liquid sidechain in a major security breach. The Bitcoin ETFs see the best three weeks of inflows in 2026.

articles.title: Satoshi-era Bitcoin wakes after 16 years of dormancy as 600 BTC moves
articles.description: Whale Alert identified 12 mining rewards totaling 600 BTC that moved after 16 years of dormancy, with the onchain tracking platform finding no connection to Satoshi Nakamoto.

articles.title: Tether-backed Orionx to shut down after audit flags $7M custody gap
articles.description: Tether-backed Orionx is permanently closing after an audit found more than $7 million in customer assets had moved to wallets outside its custody.

articles.title: Poland upholds crypto bill veto as Zondacrypto scandal widens
articles.description: Polish lawmakers failed to overturn a presidential veto of crypto legislation as the Zondacrypto investigation expands and its Estonian operator enters bankruptcy.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETF inflows hit $3.8B in strongest three-week stretch of 2026
articles.description: US spot Bitcoin ETFs drew nearly $1 billion in the latest week as Friday inflows stayed positive despite Bitcoin briefly falling below $79,000.

articles.title: Surprise nonfarm payrolls print sends Bitcoin back below 80K
articles.description: The US economy added far more jobs than expected in August, pressuring Bitcoin lower as traders repriced the odds of a Federal Reserve rate cut this month.

articles.title: Pineapple Financial puts $1B in mortgage records on Injective
articles.description: The mortgage lender plans to bring more than $10 billion in historical loans onchain, turning thousands of mortgage files into blockchain-based records.

articles.title: FinCEN ties $13B in crypto scams to non-US operations
articles.description: The agency reported that “transnational criminal organizations” based in compounds in Southeast Asia were largely behind digital asset scams targeting US residents.

articles.title: Crypto Biz: AI took a back seat when Bitcoin started climbing
articles.description: Corporate crypto bets are getting bigger as rising markets reward direct exposure, putting balance-sheet strategies and institutional adoption back in focus.

articles.title: QuFi launches post-quantum verification platform with Bitcoin testnet proof
articles.description: QuFi’s new platform uses post-quantum cryptography to verify digital asset transactions without requiring changes to existing blockchain settlement networks.

articles.title: US law enforcement group moves to ‘neutral’ position on CLARITY Act
articles.description: Despite earlier opposition to the CLARITY Act over consumer protection, the National Sheriffs’ Association says it will now “step back and allow the legislative process to proceed.“
